title: Yellowed Rich French Chestnuts Beef Bourguignon
description: A hearty and cozy French dish featuring tender beef, chestnuts, and a citrusy twist, served in a slate-tile vessel. This Mediterranean-friendly boeuf bourguignon is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef short ribs with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the beef short ribs over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chestnuts, tomato paste, red wine, beef broth, lemon juice, and thyme to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the mixture for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the bourguignon hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
